sloka: किं पुनः सहितो वीरैर्बलवद्भिः कृतात्मभिः ।कृतास्त्रैः प्लवगैः शूरैर्भवद्भिर्विजयैषिभिः ।। ५.५९.८ ।।।।
transliteration: kiṁ punaḥ sahito vīrairbalavadbhiḥ kṛtātmabhiḥ ।kṛtāstraiḥ plavagaiḥ śūrairbhavadbhirvijayaiṣibhiḥ ।। 5.59.8 ।।।।

translations.english: "When strong, wise and accomplished persons are there with me desiring victory why speak again?
